title: Targeted Evaluation, Action, & Monitoring of Traumatic Brain Injury
brief_summary: TEAM-TBI (Targeted Evaluation, Action, and Monitoring of Traumatic Brain Injury) is a research study that brings together TBI patients, advanced evaluation methods, and experts in a multi-faceted study to address the heterogeneity of TBI and to evaluate the effects self-help strategies might have on TBI outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18-60 years of age
* Fluent in English
* Documented history of TBI or blast exposure since 2001

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to have MRI
* Pregnancy
* History of TIA within last 6 months.
* Presently involved in open litigation
